notes.text: The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 6 games cover only 32% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the third-lowest in the league (a typical team: 47%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Marcus Foligno is on injured reserve and has missed the last 2 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Brock Faber is on injured reserve (skull surgery) and has not played this season. He is a top-pair defenseman. Jared Spurgeon has taken his spot beside Quinn Hughes.

stakes: The Jets go in third in the Central with 7 points, 2 points behind the Wild, first. A regulation win for the Jets would pull them level with the Wild.

WPG.head: Nothing to separate these two
WPG.body: Minnesota is on the second night of a back-to-back, while Winnipeg has home-ice advantage. Minnesota has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, though. The Jets can tip it if their power play gets going.

items.text: The Jets are newly without Connor Hellebuyck and Josh Morrissey. Stuart Skinner is expected to start.

The Wild are newly without Marcus Foligno and Jared Spurgeon, and have had to make do without Filip Gustavsson and Brock Faber all season. Calvin Pickard is expected to start. Counting how much each missing player usually brings, no team is missing more right now.
Blake Coleman is set to play his 700th NHL game.
Kirill Kaprizov has six goals in ten games against Winnipeg since 2023-24.
